summary: Give the sekrets daemon integration, delivery presence and the tile registry their own modules, and move the native-resume environment names to native_resume and the person-name rule to model; the module allowlist shrinks from 10 to 6 pairs

replay.detail: Files and definitions move between modules and keep their behaviour. No claim, projection or replay behaviour changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, schema version or migration changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol, harness, route, CLI output or exit code changes; the environment variable names are the same strings.

downtime.detail: Nothing to restart beyond a normal upgrade.
